label: CODEX DRAFT — NOT CANON
scope: Kriterien-/Befundstellen einschließlich Unterlisten und Tabellen. Historische Aussagen bleiben getrennt von aktuellem Nachweis. Jede Beleglücke bindet an ihren eigenen vollständigen Wortlaut; Dateifund ist kein Erfüllungsbeweis. Noch kein Abschluss der Autoren-Durchsicht.

records.requirementOrFinding: 1. **Source of truth = the MORE! 1–4 textbooks.** Every word, sentence, rule, and test format traces to the SB/WB transcripts, master vocab lists, check-ups, or Schularbeiten (`05`). No invented content.

records.requirementOrFinding: 2. **Grades 1–4 only. Drop 5B.** Level A1 → A2. Age-appropriate for ~10–14-year-olds. (Grades 5–8 are a separate app — never pull 5B/upper-grade material in.)

records.requirementOrFinding: 3. **Never show above-level vocabulary unglossed.** If a student-facing sentence (example, context, definition, hint, story line) uses a word the student hasn't met yet (per the cumulative unit word bank), gloss it inline on the same line: **`word (= deutsches Wort)`**.

records.requirementOrFinding: 4. **All student-facing German is informal "du."** Never "Sie/Ihnen/Ihr(e)" as address. ("sie" = she/they stays.)

records.requirementOrFinding: 5. **Answer-checking is forgiving and correct.** Accept every variant that is correct **in the sentence**; accept multiple valid phrasings; give **partial credit / half-XP** for near-synonyms or reasonable alternatives; **never** demand a verbatim citation form that makes the sentence ungrammatical.

records.requirementOrFinding: 7. **Student-facing surfaces carry zero meta/teacher-talk.** Rationale, answer keys, and pedagogy live in teacher-only views.

records.requirementOrFinding: 8. **Verify, don't trust.** No blind faith in imports or sub-agents. Generate → independent verify → deterministic validator → Koki spot-check. A broken item in front of a real child is the failure that matters.

records.requirementOrFinding: 9. **Bulletproof for students.** Never lose progress; fail gracefully; no dead ends; no unanswerable items; tested at class scale (~30 concurrent) before each go-live.
